summary: Full-stack testing of CloudWave IT Training website. Backend: 39/39 pytest cases passed covering auth, public endpoints, enquiry submission + admin management (status/notes/export), contact, generic admin CRUD (courses/faqs with slug + published), settings persistence, users mgmt, and dashboard stats. Frontend: end-to-end Playwright verified home page, courses listing (8), course-detail 'Enquire About This Course' correctly navigates to /enquiry?course=<id>, enquiry validation & successful submission (enquiry-id CW26080001 shown), contact form, admin auth (redirect + wrong-password error + successful login), dashboard stats visible, enquiries table + search + CSV export button, ResourceManager for FAQs, Settings page, Users page correctly hides delete on self/last admin. Theme announcement banner rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 761 lines with auth, CRUD factory, seed and stats all in one module. Consider splitting into routers (auth/public/admin/seed) for maintainability, but not blocking.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' while allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; production should set explicit origins in backend/.env.
seed_admin idempotency covered (updates password if changed) — good. bcrypt hashes use $2b$ correctly.
Logout endpoint does not clear cookie / invalidate JWT (stateless). Fine for MVP but callers must remove token client-side.
Generic admin PUT accepts arbitrary body (Dict[str,Any]) — no field-level validation per resource. Acceptable for MVP but risky long term.
enquiry_id uses count+1 which can collide under concurrency; consider atomic counter.
seed_data_creation: One TEST enquiry (CW26080001) and one contact msg left in DB from Playwright run. Pytest cleaned up its own TEST_* enquiries/users/courses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~7s and covers all endpoints. Rerun via: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Frontend uses data-testids as documented. Not covered explicitly: gallery lightbox prev/next interaction, blog detail rendering, admin theme mgmt UI, image upload flow — all present but not clicked through.
